figurative_meaning_en: to raise one's hand in support
example_sentences_in_bangla: সভায় প্রস্তাবের সমর্থনে সবাই হাত তুলল।
তুমি কি এই সিদ্ধান্তের পক্ষে হাত তুলবে?
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone raised their hands in support of the proposal in the meeting.
Will you raise your hand in favor of this decision?
note: This idiom is commonly used in formal and informal settings to indicate agreement or endorsement.
